descriptions.title: Zero-framework, single-file server
descriptions.body: MapSnap deliberately avoids Flask/FastAPI. Application/server.py is one ~5,000-line module built on Python's stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, dispatching ~50 /api/* routes from do_GET/do_POST. The frontend is one generated HTML file. This keeps the install dependency-light and trivially portable to a customer or air-gapped box - the same shape intended to carry to CogniBase @ BU unchanged.

descriptions.title: Engine-agnostic extraction layer
descriptions.body: db_extractors.py provides interchangeable Sqlite/Postgres/MySql/Oracle extractors (plus Chroma/Qdrant), and extract_schema.py handles SQL Server via pyodbc, all emitting one canonical schema.json object model (objects[] with columns, foreign_keys_in/out, module grouping). Drivers are installed on demand through a strict pip allow-list, so the app ships thin and only pulls the driver a given connection needs.

descriptions.title: Local-first AI with a cloud escape hatch
descriptions.body: By default every model call goes to a local Ollama model (granite, qwen2.5-coder, sqlcoder, gemma) and every embedding to local nomic-embed-text, so no data leaves the machine. OpenRouter and direct provider APIs are wired with per-provider SSE delta parsing, but a profile can only reach them when its data_policy permits - making 'use a frontier model' and 'choose what may leave' the same, deliberate decision.

descriptions.title: The guardrail control plane
descriptions.body: guardrail.py is a framework-free, importable module (so it ports unchanged) that is the single chokepoint for cloud egress. It resolves the active policy (fail-safe local_only), blocks calls outright under local_only, scrubs regulated column values and strips LOCAL_ONLY-sentinel spans (profiling samples) under cloud_metadata_only, and logs every decision for audit. It wraps both /api/chat and /api/nl2sql; local execution and local models are never touched.

descriptions.title: The per-profile knowledge bundle (sidecars)
descriptions.body: Each Product/<profile>/ accumulates plain JSON sidecars beside schema.json: annotations.json (Layer 2 purpose/role), BU_Catalog.json (Layer 3 business-name values), profile.json (Layer 4 masked samples + semantic types), a ChromaDB .index/ (Layer 5 vectors), mapsnap_meta.json (policy + classifications), and enrich_status.json. enrich.py runs the chain idempotently (source-hash gated) and best-effort, triggered by extract / doc import / config import.

descriptions.title: Vector retrieval is local and hybrid
descriptions.body: semantic_index.py builds one nomic-embed-text embedding per table from the on-disk sidecars and stores them in a local ChromaDB index. At query time the server interleaves keyword scoring with semantic matches (after the OnBase catalog/seed spine), with a pure-keyword fallback when no index exists or Ollama is down - so retrieval degrades gracefully and the cryptic-name problem ('checks' -> doctype/itemdata) is solved by meaning, not string match.

descriptions.title: Service + tunnel operations
descriptions.body: On the Quiddity host MapSnap runs as the QI_MapSnap NSSM service (AppDirectory C:\APPS\MapSnap, port 9876, rotated logs in C:\APPS\MapSnap\LOGS) behind QI_MapSnapTunnel, a named Cloudflare tunnel giving the stable URL https://mapsnap.quiddityinnovations.com. start.bat auto-detects service vs manual mode; on a shipped/customer box with no QI services it falls back to local Python plus a Cloudflare quick tunnel.
